correctness.rationale: Binomial induction raises v_p((1+p^c)^(p^j)-1) by exactly one per step in the stated p,c domain. Thus the powers enumerate the congruence subgroup 1+p^c Z modulo p^(c+k), and their divided differences are uniform modulo p^k. Subtracting the translations of xy and yx (which have the same b-exponent) gives the claimed commutator determinant with four independent uniform coordinates. A character of order p^s averages over one product to p^(-s), by annihilator counting; the second product and the t independent commutators give p^(-2st). Fourier inversion gives the exact fibers, including all valuation cases. The average absolute Ramanujan term is 2(1-1/p) for every s>=1, giving the uniform remainder by the triangle inequalities. Commuting <a^(pc exponent)> with b increases the valuation of its exponent by c, so gamma_j=<a^(p^((j-1)c))> for j>=2 until trivial and the class is 1+ceil(k/c). Central padding preserves the normalized law and makes the orders equal, including equal numbers of zero fibers off the derived groups.
